metadata.note: The radial four-valve head's two exhaust ports and their two head pipes, round the front of the engine to their join, written as one tube of their combined area: two of about 26 mm inside (1 1/8 in outside and a little under 1/16 in of wall, an owner's measurement of the XR650L's stock header, which an owners' forum says shares the XR600R's small primaries; whether it holds for the 1985 header, part 18320-MK2-670, is not confirmed). The joined pipe is 40 mm inside (1 11/16 in outside, the same measurement). Between the head pipes and the joined pipe stands an expansion chamber the motorcycle does not have (K, 2026-11-21, by ear). The silencer on the right is a wide pipe, and its outlet is as wide as the joined pipe: a narrower outlet sharpened the report and raised the closed-throttle drone. The whole run, 1.32 m, is an estimate from the wheelbase and the engine's place. All lengths are estimates; the chamber's and the silencer's widths were set by ear. Valve: two exhaust valves of 31 mm (replacement parts) and 8.0 mm lift (estimate), so the curtain is the head's area; about 265 deg seat to seat from 45 BBDC / 5 ATDC at 1 mm (Honda manual as quoted), widened as VFR750R's. Two 28 mm carburetors (1985) feed the intake, which is not modelled.
